projectDescription: A browser extension that transforms AI chat conversations into organized, navigable documents with real-time outlines, conversation folders, and a prompt library — supporting 15 major AI platforms.
keyFeatures: Real-time Smart Outline — auto-generates a clickable table of contents from any AI conversation
Conversation Management — organize chats into folders and tags with search, filters, and batch actions
Prompt Library — store, categorize, and send prompts with variable substitution and a prompt queue
Global Search — unified search across outlines, conversations, prompts, and settings with advanced syntax
24 built-in themes (light & dark) with custom CSS support
WebDAV sync for multi-device data consistency
Keyboard shortcut system with full customization
Claude Session Key management and multi-account switching
Mermaid diagram rendering, LaTeX formula support, and Markdown enhancements
Privacy-first: local storage by default, no data collection, no account required
Supports 15 AI platforms: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, DeepSeek, Doubao, Kimi, and more
publicApiSurface: Browser extension (Chrome, Edge) — Chrome Web Store
Manual sideload install from GitHub Releases
Settings → Features: Outline, Conversations, Prompts, Global Search, Queue
Settings → Appearance: theme presets, light/dark/system mode, custom CSS via --gh-* variables
Settings → Shortcuts: fully customizable key bindings
Settings → Backup & Sync: export/import JSON, WebDAV server configuration
Settings → Permissions: grant/revoke optional permissions (notifications, cookies, <all_urls>)
Settings → Site Settings: per-site model lock, Markdown fixes, Gemini watermark removal
Settings → Claude: Session Key import, validation, and multi-account rotation
Search syntax filters: folder:, tag:, is:, type:, level:, date:
Keyboard shortcuts: Alt+P (panel), Alt+R (refresh outline), Alt+K / double-Shift (global search), Alt+D (theme toggle)
